title: validate response
description: Standard output of validate in JSON mode (VALIDATE-021): ok true, the count of findings as message, a severity taken from them, and the findings. A workspace that doesn't load (COM-071), or a tool that fails (VALIDATE-013), is a refusal instead, told apart by its ok. $defs/base is ValidationResponse (overview 2.1).

base.description: ValidationResponse: severity is error when there are errors, else warn when there are warnings, else info.

errors.description: Diagnostics of any level other than warning, in the order of VALIDATE-020 (with --full, VALIDATE-046).

warnings.description: Diagnostics of level warning: dt-validate's, then the address warnings (7.4).

base_findings.description: With --full only: how many of the merged tree's findings are on nodes the overlay doesn't touch, and are left out (VALIDATE-045).

path.description: Validation-tree node segments (node<N>, ...), or the absolute path's segments for an address warning on a node no fragment holds (VALIDATE-112) and for a finding of the merged tree (--full, VALIDATE-044), followed by the property path. A diagnostic without a node has only its property path (VALIDATE-022).

anyOf.description: Where the backend is noos: the workfile's problems (VALIDATE-500). Each path is [<node>, <property>] (and the union member, when the problem is in it), or [<node>]; a warning is a required raw value left empty, or a capability mismatch an override allows (VALIDATE-501).
